question: Among resective/ablative surgery and neurostimulation (RNS, DBS, VNS, and model-guided intracranial stimulation), which intervention is best supported for patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy, as assessed by (a) literature evidence on clinical outcomes and (b) patient-specific virtual-brain simulations validated against held-out historical outcomes?
intended_use: Research evidence on literature and virtual patients. Not a clinical recommendation for any individual patient.
population: Patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy (failed >=2 appropriate antiseizure medications, ILAE definition) who underwent presurgical evaluation with intracranial EEG (SEEG or ECoG) and subsequently received resection, laser ablation, or neurostimulation.
inclusion_rules: Literature: peer-reviewed human studies (RCTs, prospective or retrospective cohorts with n>=10, meta-analyses) reporting seizure outcome after surgery or stimulation, with follow-up >=12 months.

Datasets: public or permitted-access datasets with intracranial EEG plus electrode localisation, plus a record of the delivered intervention (resected/ablated contacts or stimulation settings), plus a post-intervention outcome class.
Cases: pass R2 QC (coherent channels, units, sampling rate, coordinates, transform chain, seizure annotations); at least one annotated presurgical seizure.

Modeling basis: Wang et al. (2025) Virtual brain twins for stimulation in epilepsy, with VBT_INS_Stimulation code, once verified by R1 as a MethodCard; alternatives are a TVB Epileptor network baseline and optional BVEP.
exclusion_rules: Cases lacking electrode localisation or intervention linkage (kept as literature-only or excluded with a reason).
Pediatric-only cohorts are recorded but analysed separately unless the protocol is amended.
Multiple publications on the same patients count as one study family, not as independent evidence.

endpoints.primary_clinical: Seizure outcome at >=12 months, in the original Engel or ILAE class as reported.
endpoints.binary_mapping: Prespecified mapping v1: 'favourable' = Engel I or ILAE 1-2; everything else 'unfavourable'. Original classes are always preserved alongside.
endpoints.stimulation_secondary: Median percent seizure-frequency reduction and responder rate (>=50% reduction) at the longest reported follow-up.
endpoints.virtual_patient: Simulated reduction in seizure propagation (number of recruited nodes and seizure duration) relative to a paired no-intervention baseline, per model sample.

follow_up: >=12 months for clinical outcome; record the longest available follow-up and its definition.

split_rules.label_access: Outcome labels are sealed in the vault before modeling. Only the R5 outcome_evaluation task may reveal them, after predictions are frozen.
split_rules.leakage_controls: No patient appears in both partitions. Cohort-family overlap across datasets is recorded. Model fitting uses presurgical data only.

metrics: Literature: pooled or ranged proportion with favourable outcome per intervention class, with study count, total n, design mix, and the heterogeneity noted (no meta-analysis unless >=5 comparable studies).
Virtual patient: paired simulated effect per candidate (median and 90% interval across model samples), and stability of the candidate ranking across hypotheses and samples.

Historical validation: concordance between the model-favoured intervention region and the delivered intervention versus the binary outcome (AUC or balanced accuracy, with bootstrap 95% CI), plus abstention rate.
Reproducibility: fraction of R5 independent reruns matching R4 outputs within declared tolerance.

acceptance_criteria.evidence_claim: Supporting passage and location resolve in the cited source; population, design and endpoint transcribed correctly.
acceptance_criteria.dataset_card: Reported and verified fields kept distinct; access conditions recorded; verified fields only from inspected files.
acceptance_criteria.model_bundle: Convergence diagnostics pass (e.g. R-hat < 1.05 or optimizer converged), recovery check passes on synthetic data, posterior predictive checks reproduce presurgical seizure onset/propagation pattern.
acceptance_criteria.simulation_batch: Paired baselines present, seeds recorded, numerical checks pass.
acceptance_criteria.outcome_evaluation: Predictions frozen before reveal; metrics computed exactly as above.

budgets.compute: local machine only; no cloud spend without user approval

approvals_required: Any dataset download: dataset, size, and license named first.
Any software installation (e.g. TVB, VBT_INS_Stimulation dependencies).
